user.title: Add a Govee BLE air purifier
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of a purifier that Home Assistant can currently see. Close the Govee app first because the purifier accepts only one Bluetooth connection.

data_description.address: The purifier's Bluetooth MAC address, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.model: Select the exact model printed on the purifier.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up this nearby Govee BLE air purifier? Close the Govee app first because the purifier accepts only one Bluetooth connection.

data_description.model: Select the exact model printed on the purifier when it cannot be determined from the advertised name.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to and initialize the purifier. Make sure it is powered on, in Bluetooth range, and not connected to the Govee app.
error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.not_discovered: Home Assistant cannot currently see this purifier from a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

abort.discovery_expired: The Bluetooth discovery is no longer available.
abort.not_connectable: This discovery did not come from a Bluetooth adapter or proxy that can connect to the purifier.

communication_failed.message: The purifier did not confirm the command before the Bluetooth operation timed out.
